title: Fourier formula for total stable influence
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the Boolean cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$, and let $\\rho\\in\\mathbb R$. The total stable influence of $f$ at parameter $\\rho$ equals $\\sum_{S\\subseteq\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}} |S|\\,\\rho^{|S|-1}\\widehat f(S)^2$, where $\\widehat f(S)$ is the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$; the exponent uses the natural-number difference $|S|-1$.
